text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Experiment 195's held-out injected transfers of at least 24 hours (419 events), split into thirds by size. Each detector's found flag comes from matching to the known event. The three-list estimate is undefined in every row, so the Chao lower bound stands in for it.'
